articles.title: After homer in 10th stings them, Cardinals' comeback falls shorts in loss to Giants
articles.description: The Cardinals dropped their series finale vs. the Giants after closer Riley O'Brien allowed a two-run homer on the first pitch he threw in the 10th inning on Wednesday.
